title: ScreenshotFullPageParams
description: Scroll the session's active web page from top to bottom. PNG bytes are exported in bounded chunks through `tool.screenshot_read`, then released.

context_id.description: Context actually returned by sync. Reusable for target-policy DOM actions; strict policy consumes it after one action. Never fill it from cached state.

depends_on.description: Strict policy only: observed decision regions. Target policy requires exact business facts in expect; regions cannot be translated to facts automatically.

expect.description: Literal conditions checked before input. Selectors search the main document; use observed refs for iframe/shadow-root targets. Text includes all whitespace.

observation_id.description: Sync's baseline for untargeted/visual actions under target policy. Strict-policy drag instead accepts its legacy ref-map observation token.

scope.description: Follow appended content (default), or capture the initial document height.

timeout_ms.description: Capture and PNG encoding deadline; defaults to 120000 milliseconds.

ActionExpectation.description: Caller-supplied facts checked immediately before starting an action.

attribute.description: Required only for field=attribute, measured in Unicode code points.

equals.description: text/value require a string; checked/exists require a boolean; attribute accepts a string or null for absence. Text is exact textContent.

target.description: Observed ref or main-document CSS selector, measured in Unicode code points.
